site.name: Open Shuttlecock
site.description: A free, open-source site that reads the feathers of a badminton shuttlecock from three photos and says how sure it is.

home.title: Open Shuttlecock: read shuttlecock feathers from three photos
home.statement: Three photos of a shuttlecock. An honest read of its feathers.
home.heroAlt: A white feather shuttlecock lying on its side against a black background
home.railAlt: Several new feather shuttlecocks standing in bright light

how.heading: How a reading works
clauses: First, the whole shuttle from a step back.
Then part the feathers and move in close.
Then hold it up against a light.
Last, read what the photos show.

sample.heading: A sample reading
sample.note: This sample shows the format. It is not a real result.
sample.warning: An AI reading can be wrong. Treat it as a second opinion.

rows.name: Feather shape
rows.detail: The tips are cut to an even round arc on all sixteen feathers.

rows.name: Shaft
rows.detail: The shafts run straight from cork to tip, with no visible bend.

rows.name: Consistency
rows.detail: Height and spacing match. Two feathers sit slightly wider than the rest.

rows.name: Whiteness
rows.detail: Most feathers are clean white. Two show faint grey flecks near the tip.

rows.name: Visible defects
rows.detail: One feather has a crease across the vane. No broken shafts in view.

rows.name: Grade tendency
rows.detail: Shape and shaft point to the upper grades. The grey marks and the crease hold it below grade 1.

rows.name: Workmanship
rows.detail: Listed on its own. It does not change the feather grade.

items.title: The cork inside
items.note: Solid, layered or composite cork looks the same from outside.

items.title: Weight
items.note: A few tenths of a gram matter, and a photo has no scale.

items.title: Speed
items.note: Speed is tested by hitting the shuttle, never by looking.

items.title: Flight stability
items.note: Wobble shows in the air, after the first clear.

items.title: Durability
items.note: How many rallies it lasts depends on storage and play.

items.title: Whether it is genuine
items.note: No reading here judges a brand's authenticity.

items.title: Which factory made it
items.note: Feathers do not carry a signature a photo can prove.

items.title: What it is worth
items.note: No prices and no value estimates.

items.title: Which brand to buy
items.note: Readings and articles recommend no brand, ours included.

items.title: How it will play
items.note: No promises about performance of any kind.

items.title: That it may be wrong
items.note: The warning is fixed at the top of every reading.

items.title: How sure it is
items.note: High, medium or low for each line. No fake percentages.

items.title: What it looked at
items.note: Each line names the feature it was read from.

items.title: When a photo is too poor
items.note: Dark or blurred photos get a request to shoot again.

items.title: That damage may come from play
items.note: A used shuttle is not marked down for being used.

about.title: About
about.statement: Open Shuttlecock is a free, open-source project for reading shuttlecock feathers.
about.alt: A used feather shuttlecock lying on a wooden table

sections.heading: Who runs it
body: The project was started and is run by SP x SPORT, a sports equipment company in Australia. SP x SPORT also sells shuttlecocks.
Because of that, readings and articles recommend no brand, ours included, and no reading judges whether a shuttle is genuine.

sections.heading: How the reading works
body: The site does not train its own model. It sends your three photos to Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic, together with an open reference library of graded examples.
The reading is a tendency, not a verdict. Each line carries a confidence of high, medium or low.

sections.heading: Your photos
body: You must tick a consent box before uploading. Location data is removed. Photos that are not a shuttlecock, or that show a person, are deleted as soon as they are detected.
Photos that fail review are deleted within 30 days. Approved photos are kept and may be published under CC BY 4.0. Copies other people have already downloaded cannot be recalled.
You can ask for removal at any time with your record number.

sections.heading: Licences
body: Code is under the MIT licence. The knowledge base and data are under CC BY 4.0. Factory logos and trademarks are not open-licensed.

sections.heading: Where it works
body: Photo reading is not available in mainland China, Hong Kong or Macau for now, because the AI service it uses is not offered there. The knowledge base and questions are open everywhere.

sections.heading: Contact
body: Write to hello@openshuttlecock.com for questions, corrections or removal requests.
